description: India has achieved a remarkable milestone with its foreign exchange reserves soaring to an impressive $785.706 billion. This upswing comes on the heels of a notable rise in the previous week, primarily fueled by robust foreign currency assets. The central bank's proactive steps attracted more than USD 136 billion in fresh inflows. Conversely, there was a slight dip in the value of India's gold reserves during that period.

title: 'Trade barriers rising globally, India building bridges': PM Modi at Brics forum
description: "Today, while trade barriers are rising globally, India is building economic bridges. Since 2014, we have entered into free trade agreements with nearly 40 countries," PM Modi said.

title: Palantir cofounder Joe Lonsdale calls Trump's $5,000 checks 'bread and circus bribes'
description: Palantir cofounder Joe Lonsdale has slammed Donald Trump's proposed $5,000 dividend, calling the checks for every adult American "bread and circus bribes" in a post on X. The Republican donor said he wants the GOP to win the November midterm elections but opposes the payout, which would cost about $1.2 trillion. Other Republicans, including Representative Ralph Norman, have questioned how the US would fund it amid a $40 trillion debt.

title: 4,000 years ago, builders hauled 25-tonne stones 11 miles for Devil’s Arrows
description: Recent studies indicate that the Neolithic builders of the Devil's Arrows transported massive 25-tonne stones from Brimham Rocks, located 18 kilometers away, rather than using nearby glacial deposits. This geological research has resolved a persistent mystery regarding the stones' lineage. Additionally, a previously unaccounted for stone has been traced to a medieval cross found in Aldborough village, reinforcing local folklore about their historical significance.

title: Mumbai mall entry case: Man used ChatGPT to create fake PMO docs, police tell court
description: A 24-year-old man was arrested for impersonating a PMO official at Jio World Plaza. He allegedly used ChatGPT to create fake PMO documents and an identity card. Police seized electronic devices and documents from his residence in Khar. His private security guard, an ex-Army personnel, was also arrested with a firearm. Both accused have been remanded to judicial custody by the court.

title: Russia unveils new S-71K stealth missile for Su-57E amid potential sale to India
description: Russia has disclosed its latest S-71K Kovyor air-launched weapon designed specifically for the Su-57E fighter jet. This advanced system integrates the capabilities of both cruise missiles and drones, enabling effective stand-off attacks. With enhanced stealth features and cost-effectiveness for broader operational deployment, Russia is actively engaging India in discussions about potential joint production and technology transfer related to the Su-57E and its cutting-edge armaments.

title: 'Still have curfew?': Warner takes dig at Barmy Army, fans hit back with 'Broad' meme
description: David Warner playfully engaged with the Barmy Army on social media, starting with light-hearted jabs at Saim Ayub's batting performance. He cheekily mentioned Marnus Labuschagne's ongoing century drought and poked fun at England's curfew struggles. The Barmy Army quickly fired back by highlighting Warner's past difficulties against Stuart Broad, to which Warner humorously suggested they need to find a fresh target.

description: Nezam Hafiz, a talented cricketer originally from Guyana, lost his life in the tragic World Trade Center attacks. After relocating to the U.S., he proudly represented the American cricket team. In his honor, teammates organized memorial cricket events in New York, which persisted for years following the September 11 tragedy. A bat used during these heartfelt matches now resides in a museum, serving as a poignant reminder of his legacy.

description: Former chief selector of Pakistan cricket, Haroon Rasheed, identifies the setbacks in the sport to Imran Khan's reforms. Rasheed highlighted that Khan dismissed a hybrid model for the domestic cricket structure, significantly diminishing the first-class teams in Pakistan. He pointed out that India's layered domestic system promotes talent depth, advocating for Pakistan to decentralise its cricket governance to enhance the game.

title: 'I don't want to be murdered by a Chinese robot'
description: Hopefully, whatever version of doomsday the AI world is worried about waits until after Avengers: Doomsday, because after all the multiverse nonsense and speculation about how Robert Downey Jr is going to return to the MCU as Doctor Doom, one really wants to watch Kevin Feige explain that before artificial intelligence kills everyone.

title: Bihar’s Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata scheme: Rs 60,000 aid for landless families; key provisions explained
description: The Mukhyamantri Vas Sthal Kray Sahayata Yojana in Bihar is designed to assist landless families by providing Rs 60,000. This financial aid is specifically for those eligible for the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin to buy residential plots. The program is aimed at villages lacking government land for housing, ensuring funds are directly deposited into beneficiaries' bank accounts after thorough verification.

title: Watch: Putin takes swipe at 'so called' G7, says Brics accounts for over 40% of world GDP
description: At the Brics Business Forum, Russian President Vladimir Putin emphasized the growing influence of Brics, which now represents over forty percent of global GDP, outpacing the G7's twenty-nine percent contribution. He pointed out that these statistics illustrate the ongoing transformation of the global economic order. Furthermore, Putin and Prime Minister Modi participated in significant bilateral talks to strengthen ties.

title: France sends Rafales on 40,000-km global mission to project power from Arctic to Indo-Pacific
description: The Pegase 26 mission from France brings Rafale jets into action as they journey 40,000 kilometers across three continents. This ambitious undertaking not only demonstrates France's skills in executing swift long-distance operations but also enhances collaborative capabilities with partners through essential aerial refueling. Taking an innovative northern route crossing the Arctic, the mission underscores France's strategic prominence and dedication to bolstering global security relationships.

title: 112 years later! Robinson enters rarest Test bowling club with sub-19 average
description: In a remarkable feat, Ollie Robinson has achieved a bowling average of under nineteen after his 20th match, making him the first bowler to do so since the iconic Sydney Barnes in 1914. With two crucial wickets during Pakistan's second innings at Edgbaston, Robinson joins a select group of five bowlers with this outstanding record, positioning himself among the top wicket-takers in cricket history.

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35M mansion: Why are neighbors worried about their lake views?
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million waterfront mansion in Bratenahl, Ohio, has faced an unexpected neighborhood dispute over proposed fencing. Some residents reportedly worried the original plans could interfere with their Lake Erie views, leading to discussions with neighbors. A section of the fence extending toward the beach was later scrapped. Despite the disagreement, local officials have welcomed Kelce, while emphasizing the importance of both community ties and privacy.

title: Indian-origin taxi driver drove New Yorkers for free for 40 days after 9/11
Elon Musk's Cybercab rollout puts US safety rules to test as NHTSA audits 1,000 cars
description: Tesla's new Cybercab robotaxis are now operating in Texas without traditional controls. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has opened an audit of these vehicles. US safety regulations were primarily designed for human-driven cars. Tesla's strategy relies on self-driving software and robotics for its valuation. Experts suggest Tesla may challenge regulatory interpretations to deploy its vehicles.

title: Powerful explosion in TMC leader's house in Bengal; BJP claims bombs stored inside
description: A large explosion severely damaged a house in Baruipur, South 24 Parganas. Police suspect a gas cylinder caused the blast, while locals allege bomb storage. The house belonged to Dwijen Mondal, who has not been seen recently. No casualties were reported from the significant structural damage. An investigation is ongoing to determine the exact cause of the explosion.

title: Putin brings 'Flying Kremlin' to India for Brics: What makes 'Doomsday Plane' different?
description: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in New Delhi for a summit and bilateral talks. He traveled on a specially modified Ilyushin IL-96-300PU aircraft for security. This aircraft functions as a mobile command center with advanced communication systems. The United States operates comparable aircraft for its own national command needs. These planes are designed for survivability during national emergencies and conflicts.

title: JD(U) renaming on cards? Leaders back proposal to name party after Nitish
After Pakistan's cybercrime summons, Rizwan & Imam face domestic cricket setback
description: Following their recent tour in England, Pakistani cricketers Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq find themselves under scrutiny due to a cybercrime investigation triggered by evidence from their mobile phones. As a result of their inability to meet fitness requirements, both players will miss the opening round of the President's Trophy Grade-I, amid the aftermath of a challenging tour filled with recalls.

title: PM Modi, Putin share car ride in Delhi, weeks after traveling together in Bishkek - watch
description: During an informal car ride in Delhi, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Russian President Vladimir Putin rekindled their camaraderie, continuing their tradition of traveling together. This ride marks their fourth time sharing a vehicle, following earlier occasions in Bishkek and Tianjin. Their private talks during the journey underscore the depth of their diplomatic ties and mutual understanding.

title: Putin invites PM Modi to Russia for 24th annual summit - key points from Brics summit
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Russian President Vladimir Putin during the summit.  Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian also arrived for discussions with PM Modi.  Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected for bilateral talks and the summit.  The expanded Brics grouping focuses on development and cooperation among emerging economies.  India hosts the summit under its theme of resilience and innovation.

title: Maaya Rajeshwaran, Sushkova stun 4th seeds to storm into US Open junior semis
description: Maaya Rajeshwaran Revathi and Antonina Sushkova secured a significant victory in New York.The Indo-Ukrainian pair defeated the fourth-seeded Russian team in straight sets.They demonstrated strong serving and saved crucial break points during the match.This win follows their earlier upset against the fifth seeds in the second round.Next, the duo will face American twins Kristina and Annika Penickova in the semi-finals.

title: PM Modi's special gift to Putin comes with a Tamil connection
description: During a significant meeting ahead of the BRICS Summit, Prime Minister Modi gifted President Putin a translated version of the ancient Tamil text, Thirukkural, by Naira Mkrtchyan. Both leaders held bilateral talks on the sidelines of the Brics summit being held in New Delhi.

title: 'Double-edged sword': Sitharaman flags AI risks, urges efficiency without fragility
description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addressed artificial intelligence risks at the Global Fintech Fest 2026. She highlighted technology's potential to influence public opinion and electoral outcomes. The Reserve Bank of India recognized the Unified Fintech Forum as a self-regulatory organization. Sitharaman emphasized balancing innovation with necessary risk mitigation measures. India's young population is driving innovation and economic growth, she stated.

title: 10 days, 1,981 runs, no winner: ENG vs SA Test that ended with a ship to catch
description: In 1939, England and South Africa played a "Timeless Test" match without any time limit. South Africa batted for nearly three days, scoring 530 runs in their first innings. England replied with 316 runs, and South Africa then added 481 more. England chased a massive 696-run target, reaching 654/5 after ten days of play.

title: A ‘beer party’ trap: Man kills friend with iron rod over suspected affair with wife
description: Rewari police have arrested two individuals in connection with a recent murder case. The victim, Jitender, was found dead near the HPCL refinery on September 7. Police claim Praveen alias Papla murdered Jitender due to suspicion of an affair with his wife. Praveen and his nephew Aman Kumar were apprehended by the authorities. The accused are now in police custody for further investigation and evidence recovery.

title: UPI now dominates merchant payments: Are cards becoming less useful?
description: UPI now dominates Indian merchant payments, significantly reducing card usage. Debit cards are primarily used for cash withdrawals, not shopping. Credit cards are specializing in larger purchases and e-commerce transactions. RuPay credit cards can now link directly to UPI apps. The QR code scan is becoming the default checkout method for everyday purchases.

description: In a strategic move, Houthi forces have seized the port city of Mocha and are pushing further south towards the crucial Bab el-Mandeb Strait. This escalation shifts their tactics toward controlling Yemen's Red Sea coast, a vital route for global maritime trade connecting Asia with Europe. As tensions rise, the humanitarian situation in Yemen worsens, prompting urgent international calls for intervention to address the impending crisis.

title: A quarter century after 9/11: 25 ways America's darkest day changed the world
Red alert in Delhi after heavy rain lashes parts of city
description: Heavy rain lashed parts of Delhi on Friday as a red alert was issued. Moderate to heavy rainfall is forecast for many areas of the city. Light to moderate rain may also occur in the evening hours. Rainfall activity is expected to continue over Delhi for two days. The weather office issued the alert for the next few hours.

title: Countries where you can buy iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max cheaper than India
description: Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models have officially launched worldwide.  These devices feature the powerful A20 Pro chip and improved camera technology.  Pricing for these flagship iPhones varies considerably across different countries.  The United States offers the most affordable purchase option for both models.  India's pricing reflects higher local taxes and import duties on electronics.

title: After Trump renames Lake Ontario, Republican wants Lake Erie renamed too
description: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order directing federal agencies to rename Lake Ontario as “Lake America” on US maps, documents and databases. Canada has rejected the move, while several US governors have also said they will continue calling it Lake Ontario. The decision comes amid rising trade tensions between Washington and Ottawa.

title: Israel released 28 wild donkeys in desert; 44 years later, they created an oasis
description: In an effort to rejuvenate the parched landscape of Israel's Ramon Crater, wild donkeys were brought back into the ecosystem. These resilient animals played a crucial role by creating waterholes, which became essential for desert wildlife. Additionally, their droppings helped spread acacia seeds, promoting the growth of trees. Their natural movements resulted in water-retaining depressions, significantly transforming the area's ecology into a thriving environment that has caught global attention.

title: LeBron James on fatherhood: How did his painful past shape his promise?
description: LeBron James became a father at 19, just as his NBA career was taking off. Reflecting on his own childhood without his biological father, he told the Akron Beacon Journal in October 2004, “That’s my main goal, to try and be a better father than the one I had.” Over the years, James has emphasized family, presence and guiding his children while allowing them to create their own paths.
